derivation:
by
  intro k hk; refine HahnSeries.embDomain_notin_image_support ?_
  rintro ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩; exact hm (hx m (by simpa [show (0 : ℤ) < N by simpa using (NeZero.pos N)] using hk))
